_comment: Scaled-dork GROWTH -- the count-scaling sibling of fivecolour_domain_widen (MTG_DORK_GROWTH=0 restores the gap). Priest of Titania alone (Elf count 1) + two Forests = 3 flat mana, but the three hand casts total 5 ({G} + {G} + {1}{G}{G}). The line is payable ONLY sequentially: Forest -> Llanowar, Forest -> Mystic, and Priest -- now at THREE Elves -- taps for {G}{G}{G} to pay the Archdruid. The flat pool credits Priest at its current count, so without the EnumeratePlans growth credit the subset dies on !mana_ok before anything can offer it. Asserted via validate_line at turn == max_turns (a creature landed on the final turn wins nothing, so no win-turn assertion can see this). Executor realises the order via the growth cast tier (CastOrderRank 9) + scaled dorks tapping last (ManaSourceRank 61). USER 2026-08-20: 'play every elf we can from the list without tapping scaling dorks or Wirewood Lodge. Then we should play every elf remaining with scaled mana.'
